880-6664-8337.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6664-8337.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2099-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2099-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1887-5254-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-5254-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

141-5100-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5100-8095.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

276-330-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
You control your commander.
276-330-7839.description:
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Angrath's Marauders.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

270-1978-3099-5793.description:
Activate Hedron Archive by tapping it, adding two mana.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Hedron Archive which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

969-3259-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
969-3259-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
969-3259-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-6096.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a Goblin that doesn't have summoning sickness.
3259-5434-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and a Goblin, if needed, as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

3259-4302-4509-6968.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
3259-4302-4509-6968.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

140-2749-7433.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

141-413-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in all graveyards.
5147-6972-7231.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

560-2921-4550-7256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2921-4550-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Warhost's Frenzy triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Repeat from step 2

232-562-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Urabrask.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1829-2173-2448-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
1829-2173-2448-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2043-4715-4893-6441.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

56-792-4556-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-792-4556-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Blight Mound and Totentanz trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-792-4556-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

907-1399-1606-4452.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

678-5670-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-5670-5870.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-407-943.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Swamps.
74-407-943.description:
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Cabal Coffers.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Cabal Coffers.
Repeat.
74-407-943.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Cabal Coffers instead.

849-1117-2146-3689-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {R}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {2}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {R}.
When Junk Diver dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2222-2816-3858.notablePrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Auriok Bladewarden.
2222-2816-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auriok Bladewarden by tapping it, giving itself +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power.
Activate Auriok Bladewarden by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2 until Auriok Bladewarden has power nineteen or greater, omitting step 3 on the final iteration, if possible.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger from step 1, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

914-2499-4770.notablePrerequisites: Panharmonicon on the battlefield.Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2499-4770.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{W}.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1953-2703-3518-5112.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have summoning sickness.
1953-2703-3518-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Myr Propagator's ability by paying {3} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Mairsil using Lion's Eye Diamond's ability by sacrificing Mairsil and discarding your hand, adding {3}.
Resolve the Mairsil ability from step 1, creating a token copy of it.
Repeat.

2998-4050-4659-5003.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
2998-4050-4659-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gluttonous Troll, adding one mana of any color.
Gluttonous Troll dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Gluttonous Troll from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Gluttonous Troll enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

4403-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Slipstream Serpent.
A player controls no Islands.
4403-4447.description:
If needed, give control of Slipstream Serpent to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Slipstream Serpent's controller controls no Islands, Slipstream Serpent triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Slipstream Serpent cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Slipstream Serpent triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1496-2034-2308.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-2034-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1189-2178-2310.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Diaochan.
Diaochan does not have summoning sickness.
1189-2178-2310.description:
Activate Diaochan by tapping it, destroying an opponent's creature and any creature of that opponent's choice.
If the opponent chooses a creature you control to be destroyed, it is not destroyed due to it having indestructible.
The creature the opponent controls dies, triggering Diaochan, untapping Diaochan.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

1183-2842-3097-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1183-2842-3097-4659.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
The Pentavite dies, triggering Blood Aritst, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

1947-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to any other creature you control.
1947-5220-5243.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Reckless Barbarian dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Reckless Barbarian on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reckless Barbarian from the top of your library by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.
